brief.working_title: Design agent recovery around uncertain side effects
brief.subject: Recovery behavior at the boundary between durable outcome logs and external actions
brief.origin: A deterministic offline subprocess/SQLite experiment plus a current vendor release
brief.thesis: Recovery needs an explicit uncertain outcome and a destination lookup before replaying an external write.
brief.reader: Founder or AI architect choosing responsibility for a durable agent
brief.reader_baseline: A resumable session is enough to keep an agent working after a failure
brief.reader_delta: Can distinguish completed, retryable and externally uncertain operations and design the first recovery test
brief.stakes: Duplicate external actions and hidden human recovery work
brief.strongest_objection: An offline sequential teaching model does not validate a cloud harness integration
